thread:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: Multiple 5xx spikes and host crashloops detected from gpu-dedicated-us-central. Auto-paging this channel and PD.

alex (oncall): i'm on it. grabbing pod events, node health, and any recent infra rollouts. starting a live timeline here.

maya (sre): seeing bursts of corrected ECC memory errors then uncorrectable ECC on a subset of GPU hosts, followed quickly by kernel AER logs and then a reboot loop on two hosts. customers likely saw elevated tail latency and intermittent 502s. @elaine can you check which tenants filed tickets?

elaine (customer-success): two customers reported: SynthLabs (real-time inference) and PaperTrail (document embeddings). Both reported errors starting ~14:07 UTC. I've sent a short incident notice. No escalations yet.

pranav (runtime): runtime telemetry shows cache thrash and many retry attempts. Batchers timed-out while waiting on GPU kernels; worker pods were marked OOM-killed or node-not-ready. KV cache miss rate jumped from 8% to 46%.

maya (sre): paste from `dmesg` on host gpu-ded-07:
```
[ 3094.123456] EDAC MC0: CPU0: CE error, syndrome 0x00000000, maddr 0x7fffb7c12340
[ 3094.123459] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:8a): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 3094.123780] pcieport 0000:8a:00.0: AER: Multiple correctable error received
[ 3094.500000] kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: ECC unrecoverable
[ 3095.000001] reboot: Restarting system
```

alex (oncall): cordoning the affected pool and starting fast-drain. `rdctl pool cordon gpu-dedicated-us-central --reason "ECC+AER crashloops"`

deploy-bot: Noted. Recent infra change: kernel rollout job 8234 applied linux-6.1.18 to gpu cohort at 13:50 UTC. Autoscaling policy unchanged.

pranav (runtime): example failed request trace:
```
[REQ id=7c9f] route=/v1/embeddings model=redwood-embed latency=4214ms error=502 upstream=evicted
trace: batcher.enqueue -> batcher.flush -> worker.execute -> gpu_driver.submit -> GPU-Kernel-timeout
```

maya (sre): timeline so far (working):
- 13:50 UTC: kernel rollout (linux-6.1.16 -> linux-6.1.18) starts for GPU pool
- 14:05 UTC: first corrected ECC logs spike on host gpu-ded-03
- 14:07 UTC: first customer tickets and 5xx spikes
- 14:09 UTC: AER and Xid 79 events begin on gpu-ded-07
- 14:12 UTC: node(s) rebooting / crashlooping
- 14:15 UTC: pool cordoned and drain initiated

elaine (customer-success): shared sanitized snippet with customers. offering priority handling and will include ETA once SRE confirms mitigation.

maya (sre): hypothesis tracker (in-thread):
- H1: Kernel update produced regression that surfaces in certain host firmware/BIOS combos -> strong temporal correlation with rollout. Evidence: rollout timing + reproducible AER/ECC on recent-rollout hosts.
- H2: Intermittent hardware degradation (DIMM or GPU) on a small batch of hosts -> hardware-level ECC and Xid may indicate this; but multiple hosts across AZs reduce probability.
- H3: Workload spike (heavy DMA patterns) interacting badly with driver/kernel under certain firmware causing PCIe errors -> runtime shows bursty DMA patterns from SynthLabs.

pranav (runtime): adding that we saw concurrent NVMe command aborts on the same time windows; possible root cause span PCIe root complex affecting both NVMe and GPU devices. nvme logs:
```
nvme0: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout, aborting command
pcieport 0000:8a:00.0: AER: Device recovery failed
```

alex (oncall): mitigation actions executed:
- pool cordoned and nodes drained
- temporary routing of traffic to fallback dedicated pool in us-west-2
- autoscaler headroom increased to 1.8x for GPU pools
- quarantine tag applied: `root-cause-invest=true`

maya (sre): uploading kdump and crash tarballs to cloud support case. cloud case opened: CS-223344. Assigned cloud engineer: eva.

eva-cloud-support: we've seen partners hit similar ECC/AER sequences after kernel bumps when combined with specific BIOS/firmware revisions on our GPU host family. Recommending a canary rollback to prior kernel and requesting host firmware inventory and ECC counters. We'll repro on our canary hardware with telemetry enabled.

deploy-bot: automated note: paused kernel auto-rolling for gpu pools for 72h pending investigation.

pranav (runtime): extracted a runtime metric snippet showing the correlation between SynthLabs' large batch jobs and the time of first ECC events. Uploading job IDs and stack traces to the case.

maya (sre): next steps (in-thread):
1) Pin the pool kernel to previous stable: `rdctl pool set-kernel gpu-dedicated-us-central --version 6.1.16`
2) Request cloud firmware inventory and SMART/ECC counters for all affected hosts
3) Reimage suspect hosts to the pinned kernel and run stress repro (pci-stress + nvme-stress) in canary
4) If repro succeeds on cloud canary, coordinate fleet rollback or vendor driver patch
5) Prepare customer-safe timeline and internal RCA draft

alex (oncall): prepping handoff to next rotation at 14:45 UTC. Handoff note will include node list, crash tarball links, cloud case CS-223344, repro steps, and customer impact summary.

elaine (customer-success): will prepare a customer-facing postmortem template and gather feedback from SynthLabs and PaperTrail CSMs. Also logging SLA credit requests.

pranav (runtime): leaving pointers for eng-runtime: investigate kernel/driver DMA path changes between 6.1.16 and 6.1.18, and add a reproducible test to infra-eval harness.

ops-bot: action: increased auto-scale headroom and annotated affected pool. Automation note: cordon prevents new kernel job scheduling.

maya (sre): status update 14:36 UTC: cloud confirmed canary rollback to linux-6.1.16 stabilizes host in lab repro. They are engaging vendor for firmware patch. Keeping pool pinned and routing traffic away. Customer impact reduced but not fully resolved for heavy batch jobs. No further reboots on pinned hosts.

alex (oncall): handoff posted at 14:40 UTC. If node reboots resume: escalate to eng-runtime + request emerg fleet rollback. Also keep cloud case open and request firmware revisions delta.

maya (sre): end-of-thread checklist for post-incident RCA:
- gather full kdump + dmesg for all affected hosts (done)
- confirm repro and collect minimal repro script (in progress)
- add regression test to CI infra-eval (eng-runtime)
- decide on fleet rollback vs vendor patch after vendor response (cloud + infra)
- produce customer-safe timeline and postmortem (elaine)

elaine (customer-success): will draft the customer timeline and circulate for SRE review. Target: customer-safe postmortem in 48h.

deploy-bot: auto-rollouts for gpu pools remain paused until sign-off.

maya (sre): closing live coordination thread. transferring artifacts to #postmortems and #eng-runtime for deep RCA. thanks everyone. :coffee:
